## OfferUtils.toStruct() function

Converts an offer into the tuple object expected by viem ABI encoders.

This is the bridge from SDK/domain objects into Merkle leaf hashing, payload items, and take calldata encoding.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function toStruct(params: {
        readonly offer: IOffer;
        readonly group?: Hash;
    }): OfferStruct;
```

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.offer`<!-- -->: Offer class or plain offer input to encode.

- `params.group`<!-- -->: Optional protocol group id override encoded into the ABI offer.

## Example


```ts
import { Offer, OfferUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";
import { zeroAddress } from "viem";

const offer = Offer.create({
  market: {
    chainId: 8453,
    midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
    loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000006000",
    collateralParams: [
      {
        token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
        lltv: 770000000000000000n,
        liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
        oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
      },
    ],
    maturity: 54_000n,
    rcfThreshold: 0n,
    enterGate: zeroAddress,
    liquidatorGate: zeroAddress,
  },
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000009000",
  tick: 5_000n,
  expiry: 3_600n,
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000004000",
  maxUnits: 100n,
});
const struct = OfferUtils.toStruct({ offer });
console.log(struct.tick);
```
